meta_description: AI-Based Perishable Produce Transportation Optimizer for intelligent agricultural logistics and spoilage-aware routing

landing.headline: AI-Powered Road Transport Optimization for Perishable Produce
landing.subheadline: Find the economically optimal route minimizing transit time, transport costs, and crop spoilage losses on real road networks.

features.routes_desc: Computes multi-candidate routes on real road networks with live or estimated traffic data instead of straight-line approximations.
features.trucks_desc: Calculates fleet requirements and per-truck capacity utilization automatically based on harvest weight.
features.spoilage_desc: Integrates crop-specific exponential decay models to balance transport costs against produce decay risk.
